caption:

caption:
Here's a common myth we hear: a room refresh requires buying all new furniture. Many homeowners delay painting because they feel they need a designer sofa or imported chairs to "do it properly." This couldn't be further from the truth.

The reality is that a strategic paint palette is the single most powerful tool for transforming a space and making your existing furniture look more intentional and cohesive. The right wall colour can highlight the beautiful lines of an old wooden chair, or provide a neutral backdrop that makes a collection of different pieces feel harmonious. It's about creating a canvas that celebrates what you own, not replacing it. Good design isn't about expensive objects; it's about thoughtful choices. Colour is the most effective choice you can make.

Thinking about how to make your current furniture shine? Share this with someone who needs a little encouragement to start their project.

caption:
How long should your exterior paint really last in Ukhrul's climate? The sun and heavy monsoon rains can be demanding on any finish. While high-quality paint is the foundation, regular maintenance is what truly determines its lifespan.

Ignoring small issues like minor cracks or peeling can lead to much bigger problems down the line, as moisture gets trapped behind the paint film and damages the underlying surface. A quick annual inspection and touch-up can dramatically extend the life of your paint job, often doubling it from three years to six or more before a full repaint is needed. This proactive approach saves significant cost and protects your home's structure. It's not just about aesthetics; it's about preservation and getting the most value from your initial investment.

Save this guide before you plan your next exterior painting project. It’s a simple checklist for long-term protection.
